global: This is a spicy ramen bowl with a rich, reddish broth. Topped with chashu pork, menma, bean sprouts, green onions, and a single pea, it sits in a white ceramic bowl on a wooden table, lit warmly from above.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows dark brown grain patterns and subtle texture with visible wood grain lines.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with thin dark blue rim, smooth glossy surface, slightly chipped edge visible.
regions.soup: The spicy broth is deep red, glossy, and speckled with chili flakes, cradling noodles and toppings.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, slightly curved surface and rounded tip, showing subtle glaze texture.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows pinkish meat with caramelized, crispy browned edges and visible fat marbling.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, sliced, slightly curled pieces with a glossy, tender texture.
